entries.88daf49b3d0c581b: The part of the semiconductor manufacturing process in which electronic circuits are formed on a wafer.
entries.f0bfd3a9331dad9e: The part of the semiconductor manufacturing process in which electronic circuits are formed on a wafer. Steps such as exposure, development and etching are repeated dozens to hundreds of times to form the circuits and wiring, and the wafer is inspected while still a wafer.
